purpose: Require every shipped feature/responsibility to be audited for reality, utility, correctness, canonical ownership, intelligence fit, stale/duplicate code, maintainability, cleanup/rewrite need, assurance ownership and closure readiness.

tenOutOfTenSemantics.rule: Every applicable dimension must pass or be explicitly not applicable with rationale; serious gaps cannot be averaged away.

normalizedRepresentation.purpose: Permit a canonical high-level feature ledger plus source-driven responsibility scans and a quality overlay without duplicating shared ownership/test/profile text hundreds of times.
requirements: A deterministic executable gate must resolve one effective audit row for every shipped responsibility.
Every imported responsibility must name exactly one canonical parent or provide a complete explicit row.
Direct scan source owners and tests must remain evidence and may not be erased by inheritance.
Profile/default inheritance may fill only declared shared dimensions; feature/responsibility overrides must win deterministically.
Every effective responsibility must resolve all required audit dimensions and downstream T2-T9 assurance expectations.
Missing parent, unknown profile/category, duplicate responsibility ID, conflicting parent, unresolved override or excluded scope without explicit provenance must fail closed.

Future-program source carried in the repository may be excluded from shipped inventory only with explicit source/build/runtime evidence and a named future program; exclusion never authorizes implementation of that future program.
The normalized representation is a storage form only; it may not weaken per-responsibility closure semantics.

conditionalFeatureFields.dataTruthAssessment: Required for provider, market-data, evidence, freshness, authority, fallback and derived-intelligence responsibilities; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale is allowed otherwise.
conditionalFeatureFields.securityRightsAssessment: Required for role, session, secret, provider-rights, identity, export/import, privileged control and external egress responsibilities; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale is allowed otherwise.
conditionalFeatureFields.persistenceLifecycleAssessment: Required for durable state, cache/checkpoint, profile, identity/session, workspace, migration, install, restart and packaged lifecycle responsibilities; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale is allowed otherwise.
conditionalFeatureFields.performanceEfficiencyAssessment: Required for runtime loops, provider calls, fan-out, background jobs, rendering at scale, queues, concurrency and expensive workflows; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale is allowed otherwise.
conditionalFeatureFields.observabilityAssessment: Required when failures/degradation/health/entitlement/load/rights states must be distinguishable; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with rationale is allowed otherwise.
conditionalFeatureFields.correctiveIssue: Required when closureDecision requires blocking remediation.

permanentBoundaries.noMaximalIntelligenceBias: Deterministic responsibilities must not be made adaptive merely to appear smarter.
permanentBoundaries.noStyleOnlyRewrite: REWRITE requires a concrete correctness, ownership, safety, maintainability, performance or evolution reason and executable equivalence protection.
permanentBoundaries.noAgeOnlyDeletion: Old-looking code cannot be removed without current consumer/reachability/equivalence evidence.
